About Equity Partners

Why Andorra

Why Andorra?

A unique blend of fiscal efficiency, safety, and mountain lifestyle.

Fiscal Advantages

  • Max 10% personal income tax (IRPF)
  • 0% wealth and inheritance tax
  • Exceptionally low VAT (4.5% IGI)

Safety & Quality

  • Safest country in Europe
  • High-quality healthcare and education
  • Easy access to Spain and France

Mountain Lifestyle

  • 90% of territory is natural park
  • World-class skiing and mountain sports
  • Luxury chalets, spas, and relaxed lifestyle

The Andorra Advantage 2

Why Andorra

We open the doors to Andorra’s exclusive investment landscape by providing a structural bridge that allows international firms to deploy capital into Andorra without compromising on institutional standards.

01 | FISCAL ADVANTAGE

Institutional-Grade Tax Efficiency

Andorra offers a capped 10% corporate and personal tax regime, paired with 0% wealth and inheritance taxes. This creates a high-performance environment for capital reinvestment and long-term wealth preservation.

02 | STABILITY

Sovereign Safe-Haven Status

With a history of 700 years of political neutrality and a "Stable" outlook from major credit agencies, the Principality provides a secure jurisdiction for risk mitigation against global geopolitical and economic volatility.

03 | SCARCITY

Natural Real Estate Appreciation

Geography dictates the market; with only 4% of land being buildable, the natural supply-side constraint ensures long-term asset value growth. This scarcity, combined with rising global demand, creates a high-conviction investment play.

04 | CONNECTIVITY

Strategic European Integration

Andorra is advancing its Association Agreement with the EU, integrating the Principality into the Single Market. This evolution provides investors with a unique "best-of-both-worlds" scenario: full sovereign fiscal autonomy combined with the operational advantages of having access to major European markets.

Timeline Concept 1

Investor timeline in a horizontal card format.

A clean five-step journey that reads quickly and works well for top-level onboarding.

01

Initial Consultation

We begin with a short introduction to understand mandate, target returns, and current Andorra interest.

02

Personal Consultation Call

A more focused call to discuss profile, timeline, investment criteria, and the right entry route into the market.

03

Investment oportunity selection

Relevant opportunities are curated and shared based on fit, availability, and strategic alignment.

04

KYC & Compliance

We coordinate the required onboarding, compliance checks, and documentation before moving forward.

05

Capital Deployment

Once approved, capital is allocated into the selected opportunity and execution begins under the agreed structure.

Timeline Concept 2

Investor timeline in a vertical process flow.

A more narrative structure that works well when you want each step to feel sequential and guided.

Initial Consultation

Personal Consultation Call

Investment oportunity selection

We present a shortlist of relevant opportunities and discuss where the strongest strategic fit appears to sit.

KYC & Compliance

Documentation, source-of-funds checks, and internal approvals are handled before any capital moves.

Capital Deployment

Once fully cleared, capital is deployed into the chosen structure and we move into active execution.
